remarks: Nestled at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac, this beautifully maintained in-town Cape offers timeless charm, modern updates, and unbeatable convenience. Featuring three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, the home provides a cozy yet spacious environment. Inside, formal living and dining rooms flow seamlessly into the kitchen and family room, which opens to a sunny deck overlooking lush, professionally landscaped gardens and a fully fenced backyard-ideal for play, pets, and entertaining. The updated kitchen is outfitted with top-tier stainless steel appliances, including a Viking gas range and Sub-Zero refrigerator. The main level includes a flexible room-perfect as a bedroom or private office-with access to a full bathroom. Additional highlights include an attached garage plus carport, laundry and generous storage in the lower level, and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. With walkability to town, Mead Park, and South Elementary School, as well as the middle and high schools, this home combines the best of New Canaan living with quiet, residential charm. A truly rare find in an ideal location-move-in ready and waiting to welcome you home.
